annotations.text:
Three directions for Fletcher, all built from your real HD650 preset.

A · Console — broadcast equipment on paper. Dense, technical, mono type, channel-strip rail. Tradeoff: austere.
B · Notebook — the 1933 Fletcher–Munson lab-paper angle. Plotted figure, data table, serif. Tradeoff: slower to scan, less software-y.
C · Swiss — poster-bold: huge numerals, flat red/blue blocks, thick rules. Tradeoff: loud for a daily driver.

Settings (bottom) is drawn in A's language and moves to whichever direction wins. Pick one, mix pieces, or tear them all up.
